name: GVC-RT Latent Enhancement V1.2 Oracle Residual Codec
baseline: ell_c = ell_base + V1_stage_D.decoder(zeros[1,8,17,30], ell_base); I remains original

teacher.training_samples: V1.1 fixed Train2 six P frames, 1/8/15 in each clip
teacher.eligibility: PSNR > actual stage-D ZERO for same frame and LPIPS <= same ZERO
teacher.selection: highest PSNR among eligible candidates; ties lower LPIPS then lower step then ORIGINAL_START
teacher.no_eligible: mark unavailable; stop training rather than substitute a different target
teacher.restore_old_zero_start: ell_base + V1 stage-C decoder(0,ell_base), verified against saved start hash
teacher.residual: r_star = restored ell_oracle - current stage-D ell_c
teacher.evaluation_oracle_initialization: if all six chosen teachers share initialization use it; otherwise ORIGINAL_START; fixed from Train2 before validation
teacher.evaluation_choice: best eligible saved step under the same PSNR/LPIPS rule; if none use zero residual and mark no teacher improvement

direct.delta_rule: float32 Train2 r_star global RMS times fixed geometric multipliers, resolved before direct testing
direct.probability_scale_rule: Train2 channel RMS * sqrt(3)/pi, fixed zero-mean logistic; no source-adaptive updates
direct.symbol_type: int8 checked, overflow raises without clipping

normalization.rule: per-channel Train2 r_star RMS, no centering

training.quant_delta_rule: global RMS of E_res u on six Train2 targets after A times multipliers; resolved before B
training.sampler: seeded permutation of six samples each cycle; levels rotate independently by cycle and step
training.loss_residual: MSE in frozen normalized residual space

evaluation.A_and_B_training_diagnostics: six target frames; additionally full Train2 I/P with other P frames left at fixed ZERO, clearly labeled sparse
evaluation.formal_train2: after selected-frame quantized actual-stream gate, optimize remaining 24 P frames once at sender only; no new training/calibration
evaluation.val6: only after full Train2 actual quantized source-information gate; all 90 P frames sender-optimized, no shared parameter changes
evaluation.wrong_source: cyclic next video, same P-frame index; decode legitimate stream against its own base first; swap symbols only
evaluation.metrics: V1 RGB [0,1], valid region, calc_psnr, calc_msssim_rgb, LPIPS alex v0.1 normalize=True
evaluation.interpolation: per-video PSNR/MS-SSIM/LPIPS piecewise linear vs log(bpp), only sampled overlap and same precision

stream.factorized_probability: zero-mean logistic with fixed direct calibration or separately trained enhancement scale
